canonical_incident_record.title: UPS Haslet OptiSweep incident: AGVs unable to exchange totes
canonical_incident_record.resolution_time: 3 calendar days; exact resolution time unavailable
canonical_incident_record.incident_description: Production operations at UPS Haslet were seriously impacted when the AGV and sorter system could not exchange totes or bag out. Evidence showed lost XLE communication, failed connectivity tests, and an abnormal task state. A system purge produced interim movement and tote exchange, while later case evidence recorded resolution and closure. The reported resolution explanation attributes the communication blockage to a firewall issue.
canonical_incident_record.customer_operational_impact: Tote exchange and bag-out operations were unavailable or impaired, preventing normal sorting and seriously affecting production.
canonical_incident_record.what_resolved_it: The case records that a firewall issue was identified as blocking XLE communication with the rest of the system. The evidence also records a system purge during recovery and later case resolution/closure, but it does not specify the exact firewall change or provide a complete live-system validation.

Tasks accumulated, including 80 canceled and 88 received tasks.
